scope.question: Where did the bars that are missing on 2025-11-17 (and same-shape dates) disappear, and can the coverage guard be decided on evidence?

vendor_source.daily_archives: 全A日K/YYYY.zip, one directory per symbol (YYYY/CODE.EX.csv), 5,718 entries for 2025
vendor_source.2026_zip: updated nightly by the project updater (mtime 2026-09-23 19:57)

method.zip_vs_db: single pass over 2025.zip reading every symbol CSV; per-date symbol sets compared with both delta DBs
method.pit_replication: asof_universe rule replicated (history_window_days = (60+5)*1.6+5 = 109 natural days, bars_in_window >= 60) and validated against the official P3 dry-run per-day series

daily_metrics.hole_both: symbols present on previous session AND next session but absent on the day (single-day hole, both panels)
daily_metrics.gap_10sess: symbols with a bar within +/-10 sessions but absent on the day (robust to multi-day holes)
daily_metrics.max_run: longest contiguous numeric code run inside the absent/filtered set (structural signature of batch/chunk loss)
daily_metrics.breadth_ratio: day bar count / median of the preceding 20 sessions (the working-tree revision's day gate metric)

vendor_zip_equals_delta_per_date.result: For every trading day of 2025 the ZIP's (symbol,date) set is exactly equal to the qfq delta and the raw delta (0 differences on all 243 dates).
vendor_zip_equals_delta_per_date.consequence: No download / ingest / dedup / upsert / date-parse / merge defect exists for 2025. The bars that are missing from the delta DBs are missing from the vendor package itself.

decision_window_totals.note: identical to the P3/P3.1 official numbers (per-day table drops the last session 2026-08-31 = 5510 candidates / 6 filtered, which closes the sum exactly)

structural_signature.conclusion: Long contiguous numeric code runs are a defect signature: legitimate days never exceed run 3 in either panel over ten years; the two defective days are 23 and 57.

breadth_gate_calibration.conclusion: The 0.90 day-breadth gate has no false positive in ten years and does catch 2025-11-17 (0.8677). It does NOT catch 2025-11-18 (0.9517) - neither at 0.95.

feature_has_bar_execution_has_not.measured: 0 keys on the decision window (P3.1 evidence, independently reproduced: filtered_with_feature_bar = 0 on 435/435 sessions)

execution_has_bar_feature_has_not.measured: 2026-07-17..2026-07-31: 27 symbols per session (raw_only), 0 on all other sessions of the window

end_to_end_row_loss.note: 07-16 and 08-03 are controls outside the 07-17..07-30 gap; the defect period loses 25-31 extra rows per session (~300 rows over 11 sessions)

execution_has_bar_feature_has_not.effect: daily_feature_frame returns no row for those (symbol,date) keys, and build_dual_price_training_frame merges features with 'how=inner', so those decision rows are silently dropped from the training frame; training only masks on labels.notna(), not on feature presence
execution_has_bar_feature_has_not.guard: NONE in be2e4ef and NONE in the current working-tree revision (the day-breadth comparison sees 5495/5522 = 0.995 and passes)

decision_window_candidates.explanation: the audit per-day table skips the final session (no next day); adding 2026-08-31 (5510) closes the gap exactly

guard_recommendation.principle: Magnitude ratios cannot separate legitimate structure from defects in this window: the legitimate BSE-migration days carry the LARGEST filtered population (4.7%/day) while a real vendor hole (2025-11-18) carries 5.4% - adjacent values. Structural evidence separates them with a wide margin.
proposed_minimum_change: keep the P3.1 contract fix (three-way decision: keep / filter / fail-closed on structural defects) unchanged
keep the day-breadth gate (validated, zero false positives in ten years); consider 0.95 instead of 0.90 to also catch partial truncation (2026-04-01 = 0.9211)
ADD a contiguous-run gate on the filtered set per decision day: fail closed at max_run >= 8 (measured legitimate max 3 over 2,429 + 435 sessions; observed defect 23 and 57), audit at >= 4
ADD a one-sided cross-panel gate for execution-bar-without-feature-bar (2026-07-17..07-31: 27/day) because those rows are silently dropped by the inner join
restore the single-day ratio gate from 50% back to the measured 10% (ten-year legitimate max 3.83% daily; production legitimate max 4.73%), or drop it once the structural gates exist
re-derive the window-level 2% gate: the ten-year legitimate maximum window value is 2.0773% (2016), so 2% is falsified as a default
explicitly_not_recommended: raising any ratio threshold so that 2025-11-17 passes
treating 'both panels lack the bar' as proof of suspension (no independent PIT-safe halt source exists; the two panels share the same upstream chain)
